title: dryopteris leucolepis
intro: Dryopteris leucolepis, commonly known as silvery spleenwort, is a species of fern in the family Dryopteridaceae. It is a vascular plant that belongs to the division Pteridophyta, characterized by its delicate, lance-shaped fronds and silver-margined leaves. Silvery spleenwort is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may aid in reducing inflammation, protecting against cell damage, and preventing infections. The bioactive constituents of this plant, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and sesquiterpenes, are thought to contribute to its therapeutic actions, although further research is needed to confirm its efficacy and safety.
